text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic photographic studio character asset, natural skin pores and fine individual hair, realistic cotton and knit detail. Pure white seamless background, bright soft frontal daylight balanced fill, low shadows, realistic 50mm lens perspective, no plastic skin, no illustration or 3D, no text or labels or logos. Preserve individual face, skin tone and age from reference. One original fictional adult man age 25. East Asian man with tousled honey-ash blond layers, expressive and approachable, cream lightweight jacket over dark shirt. NEW facial design: heart-shaped face, round cheeks and a firm small chin, thin rising eyebrows, narrow long eyes with monolids, softly convex nose bridge, wide cupid-bow lips. Warm fair skin. Cream lightweight zip jacket over black crewneck shirt, black straight jeans and white low-top sneakers. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
